verdict.rationale: Netlify's Deploy Previews give every PR a full preview URL with backend features (functions, DB, env vars) tied to the branch, and this is corroborated by independent hands-on community testimony calling the PR preview integration a 'killer feature.' missing for 10: no explicit mention of ephemeral teardown/cleanup behavior or full-stack backend parity (e.g., preview-specific DB branching) in evidence.
